webshop.name: webshop
webshop.role: C1 text-game family candidate: deployment cost
webshop.note: DEPLOYMENT (README and setup.sh at the pin): Python 3.8.13 in conda, Java (openjdk 11) for Pyserini/Lucene, faiss-cpu, spaCy en_core_web_lg, and a Pyserini index built by search_engine/run_indexing.sh; the Flask site or the text env runs in one process, no other service. Product data is NOT in the repository: setup.sh fetches it with gdown from Google Drive (small: items_shuffle_1000 + items_ins_v2_1000, 1,000 products, the default; all: 1.18 M products, items_shuffle and items_ins_v2, several GB) plus items_human_ins, so those files are not pinned by hash and were not fetched. The repository (this entry) holds the code, 12,087-instruction goal files under baseline_models/data and the search engine; chromedriver (16 MB binary, only for the browser demo) is pinned large-only and never executed. Python 3.8 is end of life: a modern Python needs dependency pins checked first.
